thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-jordan — potential outage affecting Private VPC egress to external APIs (auth/observability). Check #incidents and acknowledge if you're on it.

oncall-jordan: ack — I'm awake. seeing alerts for failed outbound TLS to okta and datadog from private clusters in eu-west1 -> us-central1 path. digging. any GCP incident id? @gcp-status-bot?

gcp-status-bot: GCP incident report: https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/GCPLB-9876 — network fabric control plane experienced routing churn impacting cross-region internal load balancer paths. ETA unknown.

sre-lee: > Confirmed: healthchecks and backend connections from private VPCs failing intermittently. error rate spike at 06:12 UTC. Affected: Private deployments with cross-region egress via internal LB + NAT gateway. Severity: likely sev2 given auth and telemetry impact.

infra-alex: adding context — we use an API-proxy in us-central1 for outbound third-party APIs (Okta, Datadog ingestion). Traffic from EU clusters routes through that proxy via ILB cross-region forwarding. If cross-region routing flaps, proxy path fails and clients see TLS timeouts.

oncall-jordan: initial mitigation plan: 1) divert egress for affected VPCs to regional NAT in eu-west1 2) add temporary fallback proxy in eu-west1 3) notify customers and CS. Who can spin up the proxy quickly?

eng-ml-raj: I can build a lightweight tcp-proxy image and push to private registry. Will take ~12-15min to get a pod up in eu-west1. recommend using the existing service account and bypass ILB by changing route to point at regional proxy IP.

sre-lee: I'll prepare gcloud commands for route quarantine/rewriting. Callout: we must be careful not to create asymmetric routing that breaks return path.

sre-lee: Runbook snippet:
```
# divert egress to eu-west1 NAT
gcloud compute routes create tmp-egress-eu --network=projects/redwood-vpc/global/networks/private-vpc --next-hop-address=10.10.5.4 --destination-range=0.0.0.0/0 --priority=1000
# verify
gcloud compute routes list --filter="name:tmp-egress-eu"
```

infra-alex: I'm ready to update firewall rules for the proxy IP and open ephemeral port 8443 for outbound endpoints.

oncall-jordan: actioning now: @eng-ml-raj please push proxy, @infra-alex stage firewall. @sre-lee enact route change once proxy advertises health.

eng-ml-raj: proxy image pushed, deploying Deployment/Service in eu-west1. Healthcheck returning 200 on /health within 45s.

sre-lee: observed proxy healthy. applying route change in 2...1...

sre-lee: Applied route. Running quick test from a private VM in eu-west1 -> curl to okta:
```
curl -v https://company.okta.com/oauth2/v1/introspect --resolve company.okta.com:443:35.180.10.22
```
Response: 200 OK. Success for auth path.

oncall-jordan: monitoring metrics — auth error rate falling back to baseline, telemetry ingestion for Datadog still showing gaps for previous ~8 mins of data. continuing to watch.

customer-success-maya: already posted to impacted customer thread: "We're routing traffic through a temporary regional proxy while GCP resolves cross-region LB routing instability. No action needed on your end. We'll follow up with a timeline." Customers asking about data loss for telemetry — is there retained buffer?

eng-ml-raj: telemetry client buffers are retrying; Datadog ingestion will accept retries. we expect <10% of events may be delayed, not lost.

pagerbot: Incident timeline event logged. Incident severity set to P2 by oncall-jordan.

sre-lee: opened GCP support case: case ID 1234567890, linked to GCP incident GCPLB-9876. Requested priority escalation citing production auth failures for Private deployments.

infra-alex: note: we observed BGP-adj churn messages on our side too, likely symptomatic of the same fabric issue. Will gather logs and export for GCP.

oncall-jordan: handoff: @sre-lee will stay as incident lead for next hour. I'll go to 30m follow-up and then rotate to follow. @customer-success-maya coordinate external comms. @infra-alex pull logs and attach to support case.

customer-success-maya: sending consolidated update to affected customers: "Temporary routing implemented. We're monitoring and will update in 15 minutes. Contact cs@redwood.ai for urgent concerns."

sre-lee: update from GCP support: fabric instability is widespread; mitigation ETA unknown but they've pushed control-plane fixes to some regions. They requested packet captures and route tables — Alex, sending you the collection script I need attached to the case.

infra-alex: attaching pcap and route dump to support case. snippet used:
```
sudo tcpdump -i ens4 host 35.180.10.22 -w /tmp/gcp-egress.pcap
gcloud compute routes list --project=redwood-prod > /tmp/routes.txt
```

eng-ml-raj: telemetry backfill running. pushing status: 60% of the delayed batches already retried, ingestion latency back to normal in eu-west1.

oncall-jordan: final checks: 1) auth success rate stable for 5m 2) no new error spikes 3) GCP support still investigating. Rolling incident to monitoring. I'll keep the runbook open and will finalize the postmortem owner in 1h. Any objections to closing the active pager?

sre-lee: no objections. keep case open with GCP until control plane is fully stable. Recommend post-incident action items: 1) pre-provision regional proxies for quicker failover 2) automated health-based route switches 3) update runbook with exact gcloud commands and firewall caveats.

customer-success-maya: will draft customer-facing post-incident note emphasizing retries and minimal data loss.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: @oncall-jordan acknowledged resolution and closed active pager at 1772004445. Incident remains in monitoring until GCP resolves GCPLB-9876.

oncall-jordan: assigning postmortem owner: @sre-lee. Please include timeline, mitigation steps, customer impact estimate, and follow-ups for runbook/provisioning. I'll post an internal summary to #incidents once finished.

sre-lee: got it — starting postmortem draft. includes attachments: route dumps, pcaps, GCP case ID 1234567890, and notes about proxy failover timeline.

customer-success-maya: will prepare customer bulletin draft for legal/comms review.

eng-ml-raj: leaving note: consider adding exponential retry with jitter for telemetry clients to reduce perceived loss during infra blips.

pagerbot: Incident marked P2, notification suppressed. End of thread.
